description: Land Acquisition - Karagasthalawa, Imbulpe D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1859/25 of 24.04.2014
reasoning: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition for a public purpose (Karagasthalawa Primary School).
